tools.title: Yale GIS Accelerator and Remote Sensing Accelerator
tools.description: Five-day intensive hybrid training for Yale affiliates in GIS and remote sensing.
tools.keywords: training workshop course learn gis remote sensing beginner

tools.title: LLM-Find data retrieval agent
tools.description: Agent that writes and runs code to download data from OpenStreetMap, Census, OpenTopography and other sources, guided by handbooks.
tools.keywords: agent download data automatically osm census handbook llm

tools.title: Research Architect
tools.description: Builds and edits the influence graph of a research question, then checks scope and data coverage in depth.
tools.keywords: research design causal graph influence graph scope coverage question framing

methods.title: Zonal statistics
methods.description: Summarize a raster (mean, sum, share of class) inside polygons such as tracts or parcels.
methods.keywords: zonal statistics raster polygon summary mean exposure land cover share
methods.inputs: A raster and polygons in the same projection
methods.pitfalls: Edge pixels and polygons smaller than a pixel give unstable values.

methods.title: Population-weighted exposure
methods.description: Weight an environmental surface by where people live, not by area.
methods.keywords: population weighted exposure environmental health air pollution heat
methods.inputs: An exposure raster and gridded or block population
methods.pitfalls: Residential location is not where people spend the day.

methods.title: Areal interpolation and boundary crosswalks
methods.description: Move counts between mismatched units, such as 2010 to 2020 tracts or tracts to towns.
methods.keywords: crosswalk areal interpolation boundary change tract vintage harmonize
methods.inputs: Source counts, target units, a crosswalk or weights
methods.pitfalls: Area weighting assumes people spread evenly; use population weights.

methods.title: Spatial join, buffers and overlay
methods.description: Attach attributes by location, count points in areas, or measure what lies within a distance.
methods.keywords: spatial join buffer overlay intersect distance count points
methods.pitfalls: Wrong projection gives wrong distances; use a local projected CRS.

methods.title: Spatial interpolation (IDW, kriging)
methods.description: Estimate a surface between monitoring points.
methods.keywords: interpolation kriging idw surface monitors stations
methods.pitfalls: Sparse monitors give smooth surfaces that miss local hot spots.

methods.title: Data fusion and downscaling
methods.description: Combine monitors, model output and satellite data into a finer surface, with uncertainty.
methods.keywords: data fusion downscaling calibration residual kriging machine learning air quality
methods.pitfalls: Validate with spatially blocked folds; random folds overstate accuracy.

methods.title: Spatially blocked cross-validation
methods.description: Hold out whole regions to test whether a model works in places it has not seen.
methods.keywords: validation cross validation spatial blocking autocorrelation overfitting accuracy
methods.pitfalls: Random splits leak information between nearby points.

methods.title: Hot spot and cluster analysis
methods.description: Find clusters of high or low values (Getis-Ord Gi*, local Moran's I).
methods.keywords: hot spot cluster getis ord lisa moran autocorrelation
methods.pitfalls: Results depend on the neighbor definition and the unit size.

methods.title: Spatial regression and GWR
methods.description: Model outcomes while accounting for spatial dependence or effects that vary by place.
methods.keywords: spatial regression lag error gwr geographically weighted
methods.pitfalls: Check residual autocorrelation; GWR needs many units.

methods.title: Difference-in-differences with places
methods.description: Estimate the effect of a policy that reached some places and not others.
methods.keywords: difference in differences policy effect causal event study treatment towns
methods.inputs: Panel of places before and after a change
methods.pitfalls: Spillovers across borders break the comparison.

methods.title: Supervised land cover classification
methods.description: Train a classifier (e.g., random forest) on labeled pixels from Sentinel-2 or Landsat.
methods.keywords: land cover classification random forest supervised training samples satellite
methods.pitfalls: Train and test samples from the same patches overstate accuracy.

methods.title: Deep learning segmentation of very high resolution imagery
methods.description: Map small objects such as pools, roofs, trees or damage in sub-meter imagery or drone data.
methods.keywords: deep learning segmentation object detection very high resolution drone aerial small features
methods.pitfalls: Models trained on one sensor or season often fail on the next.

methods.title: Change detection and time series
methods.description: Track change over years (NDVI differencing, LandTrendr, CCDC) or seasons.
methods.keywords: change detection time series ndvi landtrendr ccdc trend deforestation canopy loss
methods.pitfalls: Clouds, sensor changes and season differences look like change.

methods.title: Accessibility and travel time
methods.description: Measure access to services by network travel time or two-step floating catchment.
methods.keywords: accessibility travel time network 2sfca service area access to care food polling places

methods.title: Terrain and hydrology from elevation
methods.description: Derive slope, flow accumulation, depressions and wetness index to find where water collects.
methods.keywords: terrain hydrology flow accumulation depressions wetness index standing water dem lidar
methods.inputs: A DEM, ideally lidar at 1 to 2 m
methods.pitfalls: Coarse DEMs miss small depressions; check field conditions.

methods.title: Street view image analysis
methods.description: Measure greenery, sidewalks or building features from street-level photos.
methods.keywords: street view imagery segmentation greenery sidewalks built environment
methods.pitfalls: Coverage and capture dates are uneven; check image terms.

methods.title: Mobility and visitation analysis
methods.description: Study visits, origin-destination flows and recovery from smartphone-based mobility data.
methods.keywords: mobility foot traffic origin destination flows visits recovery smartphone
methods.inputs: Visit counts or OD flows by place and time
methods.pitfalls: Panel sampling changes over time; normalize by device counts.

methods.title: Georeferencing and digitizing historical maps
methods.description: Align scanned maps to coordinates and trace features for change analysis.
methods.keywords: historical maps georeference digitize scanned sheets change over time
methods.pitfalls: Old maps have distortions; report the error.

methods.title: Structured extraction from documents
methods.description: Turn ordinances, reports or disclosures into tables with an LLM, keeping a quote and page for each value.
methods.keywords: document extraction llm text tables ordinances official statements quotes
methods.pitfalls: Check every value against the quote; flag not found instead of guessing.
